description_en: Updates a hierarchy level. This operation will be replaced soon. We recommend that you do not call this operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateTableLevel更新层级。不建议使用该API，后续将有新API上线覆盖此功能
name: UpdateTableLevel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The table level type. Valid values: 1 and 2. The value 1 indicates the logical level. The value 2 indicates the physical level
parameters.help_zh: 层级的类型，包括1（逻辑层级）和2（物理层级）
parameters.name: level_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the table level
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the table level
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the table level. You can call the ListTableLevel operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的层级ID。您可以通过ListLevel获取
parameters.name: level_id
